description: Development set for context-aware compatibility rules. This file may be used for bridge tuning and must not be reported as blind external accuracy.
selection_policy: Near-neighbor cases derived from missed external categories, but not the frozen Q2 blind pair identities.

pairs.citation: Nitta et al., Materials Today 2015, Li-ion battery materials and current collectors
pairs.evidence_basis: Al foil is a standard positive-electrode collector in LiPF6 carbonate cells.

pairs.citation: Morita et al., Journal of Power Sources 2001, aluminum corrosion in LiTFSI electrolyte
pairs.evidence_basis: LiTFSI can drive severe Al current-collector corrosion without inhibitors.

pairs.citation: Mikolajczak et al., Lithium-Ion Batteries Hazard and Use Assessment, Springer 2011
pairs.evidence_basis: Nickel tabs are common Li-ion hardware and should not be scored as full cathode collector foils.

pairs.citation: Zhang, Journal of Power Sources 2006, copper dissolution at high positive potentials in Li-ion batteries
pairs.evidence_basis: Cu dissolves at cathode potentials and is not a cathode current collector.

pairs.citation: Mindemark et al., Progress in Polymer Science 2018, polymer electrolytes for lithium batteries
pairs.evidence_basis: PEO oxidative stability is inadequate for high-voltage NMC cathodes without protection.

pairs.citation: Mindemark et al., Progress in Polymer Science 2018, polymer electrolytes for lithium batteries
pairs.evidence_basis: PEO systems are commonly considered with lower-voltage LFP chemistry.

pairs.citation: Bresser et al., Energy & Environmental Science 2018, binder selection by electrode chemistry
pairs.evidence_basis: CMC/SBR aqueous binder systems are primarily anode binders, not default high-voltage oxide cathode binders.

pairs.citation: Bresser et al., Energy & Environmental Science 2018, binder selection by electrode chemistry
pairs.evidence_basis: SBR is used with CMC-type aqueous binder systems for graphite anodes.

pairs.citation: Bresser et al., Energy & Environmental Science 2018, binder selection by electrode chemistry
pairs.evidence_basis: CMC is a common aqueous binder for graphite anodes.
Polyethylene and PET are immiscible without a compatibilizer.

pairs.citation: Robeson, Polymer Blends: A Comprehensive Review (2007); PE/PP is the canonical immiscible polyolefin blend.
pairs.evidence_basis: HDPE and PP are thermodynamically immiscible (positive Flory-Huggins chi); they phase-separate without a compatibilizer. Co-processing in recycled streams gives weak two-phase blends, not a compatible blend. Relabeled 2026-05-30: prior 'true' used a looser co-processability sense inconsistent with the rest of the polymer set (PP+PET, PS+PP also false).

pairs.citation: Zhang, Journal of Power Sources 2006, current collector corrosion and high-voltage Li-ion limits
pairs.evidence_basis: Stainless steel is not a standard high-conductivity high-energy cathode collector.

pairs.citation: Current collector review for lithium-ion batteries, Journal of Power Sources 2021
pairs.evidence_basis: Silicon and other low-potential negative electrodes conventionally use copper current collectors; aluminum foil is positive-electrode collector hardware.

pairs.citation: Nitta et al., Materials Today 2015, Li-ion battery materials and current collectors
pairs.evidence_basis: Stainless steel is not a standard high-conductivity foil current collector for Li-ion positive-electrode coatings.
